verdict.rationale: A robotics platform could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that external AI agents can drive Viam through its CLI, SDKs, and llms.txt. That is a building block for outside agents, not an assistant built into the Viam app that users can hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
